output.answer_markdown: Industry supply conditions drive cement prices: added production capacity or rising cement imports tend to create an oversupply, which can push product prices down [1]. Cement is a commodity whose price is highly sensitive to changes in supply and demand [2]. For ready mixed concrete, cement is a key raw material, and the company may be unable to pass cement cost increases on to customers [3]. Higher cement prices may therefore hurt ready mixed concrete profitability while benefiting the cement business, though the positive effect may not map directly onto the ready mixed concrete impact [4].
